title: 40x leverage trader opens $38.7M BTC long position
summary: According to on-chain analyst ai_9684 xtpa, an address beginning with 0x854, known as a "40x leverage short-term trader," opened a 603.71 BTC long position worth about $38.67 million with 40x leverage. The entry price was $64,469, and the position is currently showing an unrealized loss of about $259,000. The address also placed limit buy orders worth a combined $31.44 million in the $63,500-$63,674 range. If all orders are filled, the total position size would expand to about $70.11 million. The analysis found the trader has mainly used a short-term strategy of closing positions within a few hours, and the current position is the trader's sixth-largest this year. If the limit orders are all executed, it would become the trader's largest position this year.

title: Dango to shut down service, halt trading on July 29
summary: One-stop trading platform Dango announced through its official channels that it will shut down after determining it is no longer feasible to continue the business. The team said user funds remain safely held and that withdrawal restrictions will be lifted in the near term.Dango will halt trading at 12:00 p.m. UTC on July 29, and all remaining positions will be liquidated in a batch at oracle prices. DLP deposits will be unlocked, and all funds will be returned to spot accounts in USDC. The platform said operations of the Dango L1 blockchain will also end at 12:00 p.m. UTC on Aug. 13. Deposits not withdrawn by that time will be refunded to the Ethereum addresses originally used for the deposits.
